WebsiteDown.summary: Website content check failed or telemetry is missing
WebsiteDown.description: At least one configured external probe is failing, or no website probe data is arriving.

ApiReadinessDown.summary: API readiness check failed or telemetry is missing
ApiReadinessDown.description: The external /api/status check must return HTTP 200 and JSON status UP.

AlloyCollectorDown.summary: alloy metrics scrape failed or telemetry is missing
AlloyCollectorDown.description: A failed scrape or absent target is unhealthy. A stopped collector becomes absent after the datasource lookback interval.

ApiMetricsMissing.summary: api metrics scrape failed or telemetry is missing
ApiMetricsMissing.description: A failed scrape or absent target is unhealthy. A stopped collector becomes absent after the datasource lookback interval.

EngineWorkerCollectorDown.summary: engine-worker metrics scrape failed or telemetry is missing
EngineWorkerCollectorDown.description: A failed scrape or absent target is unhealthy. A stopped collector becomes absent after the datasource lookback interval.

HostMetricsMissing.summary: host metrics scrape failed or telemetry is missing
HostMetricsMissing.description: A failed scrape or absent target is unhealthy. A stopped collector becomes absent after the datasource lookback interval.

ContainerMetricsMissing.summary: alloy metrics scrape failed or telemetry is missing
ContainerMetricsMissing.description: A failed scrape or absent target is unhealthy. A stopped collector becomes absent after the datasource lookback interval.

WorkerThreadsDegraded.summary: Worker threads or their telemetry are missing
WorkerThreadsDegraded.description: Expect exactly the configured one or two live thread slots, including active-state and last-successful-poll telemetry.

WorkerPollingStalled.summary: An idle worker thread has stopped polling
WorkerPollingStalled.description: A thread has been idle with no successful poll for over five minutes, sustained for another five minutes. Active jobs are excluded.

WorkerLongRunningJob.summary: A worker job has been active for over 30 minutes
WorkerLongRunningJob.description: Long-running work is not a polling failure. Investigate job progress before treating this as a stuck job.

WorkerQueueSnapshotStale.summary: Worker queue snapshot failed or is stale
WorkerQueueSnapshotStale.description: The queue sampler failed, never completed a snapshot, or its last successful snapshot is over three minutes old.

WorkerQueueDelayOverdue.summary: Ready work has waited over ten minutes
WorkerQueueDelayOverdue.description: Ready-to-run work only: future schedules and retry backoff are excluded. Check snapshot health before interpreting cached queue values.

WorkerQueueBacklog.summary: More than 100 ready jobs are queued
WorkerQueueBacklog.description: The ready backlog remains over 100 jobs for ten minutes; tune from measured beta traffic.

WorkerNewDeadLetters.description: New durable dead-letter transitions in the last fifteen minutes, including stale-lease recovery. Existing historical DEAD rows alone do not trigger this rule.

WorkerRepeatedFailures.summary: Repeated worker failures are consuming retries
WorkerRepeatedFailures.description: Five or more failed durable attempts in fifteen minutes. Continuations, busy-scope deferrals and shutdown hand-backs are not failures.

ApiHigh5xxErrorRate.description: No errors or no requests is healthy when API scraping works. Missing API telemetry is not treated as recovery.
ApiHigh5xxErrorRate.expr: clamp_max((((sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="adept-api",environment="__ENV__",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="adept-api",environment="__ENV__"}[5m])) or vector(0)), 0.001)) > bool 0.05) + ((min(up{job="adept-api",environment="__ENV__"}) == bool 0) or vector(1)), 1)

HostDiskSpaceLow.summary: Root filesystem has less than fifteen percent available
HostDiskSpaceLow.description: Root filesystem has less than fifteen percent available

HostMemoryPressure.summary: Available host RAM is below ten percent
HostMemoryPressure.description: Available host RAM is below ten percent

HostCpuPressure.summary: Host CPU usage is above eighty-five percent
HostCpuPressure.description: Host CPU usage is above eighty-five percent

HostSwapPressure.summary: Host swap usage is above eighty percent
HostSwapPressure.description: Sustained swap occupancy is a pressure signal, not proof of current swapping. A host with zero configured swap is healthy for this rule.
